finding_key: packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts::a table cell that is not an object is silently skipped rather than repaired or rejected, leaving a stored shape the table renderer dereferences unconditionally.
evidence: Verified in docs-content.controller.ts (assertValidElementData, table branch): `if (!cell || typeof cell !== 'object' || Array.isArray(cell)) continue;` skips non-object cells, which are then persisted verbatim — neither the `cell.body = { blocks: [] }` repair nor a 400 applies, contradicting the diff's own rest-api.md rule. In packages/slides/src/view/canvas/table-renderer.ts, a truthy non-object cell (string/array) passes the `!cell || isCovered(cell)` guard and crashes at `paddingOf(cell)` (`cell.style.padding`) and `isBlocksEmpty(cell.body.blocks)`, so the deck becomes a TypeError for every viewer. The one overstatement is the `null` example: the renderer's `!cell` guard skips null cells safely, but the defect stands for string/array cells.
